newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Connect wins Austria GSM licence for 2.3 bln ats.
newsitem.headline: Connect wins Austria GSM licence for 2.3 bln ats.

text.p: Connect consortium, including industrial group Radex-Heraklith and Britain's Orange has won Austria's third GSM mobile telephone licence for 2.3 billion schillings, the transport ministry said.
The transport ministry said the consortium, which also includes Germany's Viag, would create 500 jobs in the coming months and a further 500 in the next few years.
"An expected investment volume of more than 6.5 billion schillings will contribute indirectly to the creation of another 2,000 to 3,000 jobs," it said in a statement.
Orange, which had originally submitted a bid for the licence with Creditanstalt bank, switched to the Connect consortium a few days ago, the ministry said.
"The participation of Orange in Connect Austria means that...the knowhow of four internationally experienced mobile telephone operators will go into building up the Austrian network," it continued.

A spokesam for Connect broke down the consortium as follows: Radex 20.1 percent, Viag 20 percent, Norwegian Telenor 17.45 percent, Orange 17.45 percent, Danish Tele Danmark 15 percent and unlisted Austrian bank Constantia Privatbank 10 percent.
